title: The delta left Durable session timeline service accepting a repeat on equal kind, turn, and text, while the code refuses a differing classified operation
resolution: A MODIFIED requirement copies the living text and adds the optional operation to the digest, keeps the old digest when it is absent, and adds a scenario for each; proposal names it; 489 characters; scratch archive passed.

title: The in-memory command adapter appended a repeated command ID that the PostgreSQL outbox refuses, and the old-record test relied on that
resolution: The adapter answers conflict for a held ID, after the no-reader check as in PostgreSQL. A new test covers the refusal and rollback, with a fail-before; the legacy fixture now has neither a stored ID nor a prior command.

title: The scenario said a stopped session or a turn of unknown acceptance writes no command, though a response is still delivered and only the next turn of that generation is held
resolution: Split into a failed change, a stopped session, and a turn of unknown acceptance, the last two limited to session.turn.deliver; a new test pins the response of a stopped session, seen failing under a mutation.

title: The no-reader rule covered every response, though the code skips a host's delegation result, which produces no command
resolution: Rule 9 of section 5.2, the requirement, and its scenario now name a response of a principal or a standing rule, which produces session.response.deliver. Text only; the code is unchanged.

title: The commands port test restored the assignment as state running, which is not an assignment state
resolution: The test restores offered, the state the placed assignment held, confirmed by a temporary query; test only, so no fail-before. A mutation dropping the generation check fails the restored assertion.

title: The delta, proposal, and verification said no running assignment, while the adapter accepts any assignment whose state is not ended
resolution: The three records now say an assignment that has not ended, as the adapter's state !== 'ended' does. Text only; the code is unchanged.

title: No test asserted that the start of the next generation delivers the next turn once and never the turn of unknown acceptance
resolution: The test continues with endGeneration(1) and started(2) and asserts one session.turn.deliver, for the second turn. It passed at once; a mutation of dueTurn that picks the outcome-unknown turn fails it.

title: TurnCommandRecord collided with TurnCommand, a person's turn submission, giving turn command two meanings in one module
resolution: Renamed to TurnDeliveryRecord in session-records.ts and the package's index.ts, in keeping with the deliveryCommands field.

title: The statuses of respondToNativeRequest did not name the 503 of a response that no worker can read
resolution: One sentence names 503 under rule 9 of session timeline section 5.2; the request stays open and no idempotency key is stored. No code change.
